content: Official NIP-07, NIP-46 and NIP-55 plus current client/signer sources establish browser extension, relay-mediated remote signer, and Android signer paths. Flotilla supports NIP-07, Amber via NIP-55, bunker/QR NIP-46, and iOS signer deep links. Nostrord supports NIP-07/NIP-46 and current Android NIP-55 code, while its iOS client remains marked in development. Jumble supports NIP-07 and NIP-46 QR/bunker. Amber is current on Android; iOS NIP-46 signer options exist but require explicit compatibility testing. Support claims do not replace a client-signer-relay matrix.
